citation.short_title: Melvin-Koushki, The New Brethren of Purity (2025)

content: The paper says that in the early fifteenth century denunciation was rife and eminent Sunni scholar-jurists like Ibn Turka could be and were tarred by jealous rivals with accusations of unorthodoxy, even Ismāʿīlism, with some success, and that the sharpest thorn in his side was the Ḥurūfiyya.
